summary.text: Data-driven Systems Architect & Operations Specialist combining a Data Science background with expertise in cross-functional workflow optimization to build systems that create clarity, consistency, and forward momentum. My work includes automating reporting workflows that saved 12+ hours of manual work per week, leading a 34-member organization through KPI-based governance, and coordinating large-scale events for more than 1,000 attendees. I bring a structured, data-informed approach to execution, improvement, and team alignment. Passionate about leveraging emerging data technologies and agile methodologies to build resilient, future-ready organizations.

details: Implemented the comprehensive restructuring of daily sprint dashboards across all segments, delivering real-time, granular data visualization to drive strategic decision-making and future planning.
Successfully executed a total overhaul of Call Frequency Management (CFM) operations across 31 depots throughout West Java, significantly optimizing service efficiency.
Engineered a new analytical dashboard application for the Route-to-Market (RTM) division, providing comprehensive data analytics for all outlets and segments across the entire depot network.
Designed and implemented automated reporting systems using Excel, reducing manual reporting workload by ~12 hours per week.
Standardized cross-functional SOPs across Finance, Sales, and Operations to improve operational consistency.
Leveraged data analytics on internal feedback to engineer structured process improvements, directly influencing management decisions.
Ensured operational readiness of safety equipment through structured inspection and maintenance systems.
Supported technical training sessions as lead climber and belayer for rescue operations.
Facilitated technical instruction delivery and conducted rigorous skill assessments for new trainees.
Led 34-member organization across 10 divisions using structured KPI-based governance.
Architected and executed long-term institutional programs successfully adopted school-wide.
Directed strategic outreach campaigns to 12 feeder schools.
Implemented weekly operational coordination rhythm to maintain cross-divisional alignment.
Coordinated backstage technical execution for events with 1,000+ attendees.
Reduced transition downtime by enforcing structured stage workflows across lighting, sound, and security teams.

impact.desc: Led a 34-member student council across 10 divisions at SMA Santa Maria 2 through KPI-based governance and weekly coordination rhythms. Designed institutional programs adopted school-wide and directed strategic outreach to 12 feeder schools.

impact.desc: Managed program flow as MC at Youth Mass 2025 (GEMA Bandung) for 500+ participants, coordinating speakers, committees, and technical teams. Previously handled backstage operations for 1,000+ attendee events, reducing transition downtime through structured stage workflows.
